d: Wide country with huts; wood on both sides, and great mountain in prospect. Meleagro, with the name of Tirsi
Atalanta with the name Amarilli, followed by Meleagro and other shepherds
Atalanta, followed by Ninfe and Pastors
Irene, then Aminta strale neck, which gave him Atalanta, to present to Meleagro
Aminta, Irene and Meleagro in the background
Atalanta, Meleagro, Nicandro with Irene and Aminta, who held hands
